title: sinapidendron frutescens
intro: Sinapidendron frutescens, commonly known as the prickly lettuce, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include alleviating fever, reducing inflammation, and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Sinapidendron frutescens include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating respiratory issues and other ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
